import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Features
target = "admitted"
cat_feats = [
    "disability_status",
    "first_generation",
    "gender",
    "race",
    "region",
    "socioeconomic_status",
    "urban_rural",
]
numeric_feats = [
    c
    for c in train_df.columns
    if train_df[c].dtype in ["int64", "float64"] and c != target
]

# One-hot encoding
train_dummies = pd.get_dummies(train_df[cat_feats], prefix=cat_feats)
X_full = pd.concat([train_df[numeric_feats], train_dummies], axis=1).values
y_full = train_df[target].values

# Prepare test encoding
test_dummies = pd.get_dummies(test_df[cat_feats], prefix=cat_feats)
test_dummies = test_dummies.reindex(columns=train_dummies.columns, fill_value=0)
X_test = np.concatenate([test_df[numeric_feats].values, test_dummies.values], axis=1)

# Cross-validation
kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
metrics = []
for train_idx, val_idx in kf.split(X_full):
    X_tr, X_val = X_full[train_idx], X_full[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y_full[train_idx], y_full[val_idx]
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_val)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred)
    # fairness: demographic parity gap for each protected attribute
    gaps = []
    prot_attrs = ["race", "gender", "socioeconomic_status"]
    val_df = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
    for attr in prot_attrs:
        ps = []
        for grp in val_df[attr].unique():
            mask = val_df[attr] == grp
            if mask.sum() > 0:
                ps.append(y_pred[mask.values].mean())
        if ps:
            gaps.append(max(ps) - min(ps))
    avg_gap = np.mean(gaps) if gaps else 0
    metrics.append(acc - avg_gap)

metric = np.mean(metrics)
# Train final model and predict test set
final_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(random_state=42)
final_model.fit(X_full, y_full)
test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)
# Save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Composite metric (accuracy - avg parity gap): {metric:.4f}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from xgboost import XGBClassifier

# load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# features and target
target = "admitted"
cat_cols = [
    "disability_status",
    "first_generation",
    "gender",
    "race",
    "region",
    "socioeconomic_status",
    "urban_rural",
]
X = train.drop(columns=[target])
y = train[target].values
X_test = test.drop(columns=[target])

# encode categoricals
enc = OrdinalEncoder()
X[cat_cols] = enc.fit_transform(X[cat_cols])
X_test[cat_cols] = enc.transform(X_test[cat_cols])


# function to compute equal opportunity gap for one fold
def eq_opp_gap(y_true, y_pred, groups):
    tprs = []
    for g in np.unique(groups):
        mask = groups == g
        pos = y_true[mask] == 1
        if pos.sum() > 0:
            tprs.append(((y_pred[mask] == 1) & pos).sum() / pos.sum())
    return max(tprs) - min(tprs) if tprs else 0.0


# cross-validation
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
composites = []
for tr_idx, val_idx in skf.split(X, y):
    X_tr, X_val = X.iloc[tr_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y[tr_idx], y[val_idx]
    # train model
    model = XGBClassifier(
        use_label_encoder=False, eval_metric="logloss", random_state=42
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    # predict
    y_pred = model.predict(X_val)
    # accuracy
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred)
    # gaps
    gap_race = eq_opp_gap(y_val, y_pred, X_val["race"])
    gap_gender = eq_opp_gap(y_val, y_pred, X_val["gender"])
    gap_ses = eq_opp_gap(y_val, y_pred, X_val["socioeconomic_status"])
    avg_gap = np.mean([gap_race, gap_gender, gap_ses])
    composites.append(acc - avg_gap)

# report metric
composite_metric = np.mean(composites)
print(f"Composite metric: {composite_metric:.4f}")

# retrain on full data and predict test
final_model = XGBClassifier(
    use_label_encoder=False, eval_metric="logloss", random_state=42
)
final_model.fit(X, y)
test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)

# save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define protected attributes and feature set
protected_cols = ["race", "gender", "socioeconomic_status"]
features = [c for c in train.columns if c not in protected_cols + ["admitted"]]

X = train[features]
y = train["admitted"]
prot = train[protected_cols]

# Identify numeric and categorical features
numeric_feats = X.select_dtypes(include=["int64", "float64"]).columns.tolist()
cat_feats = X.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()

# Build preprocessing and model pipeline
preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
    [
        ("num", StandardScaler(), numeric_feats),
        ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat_feats),
    ]
)
model = Pipeline(
    [
        ("pre", preprocessor),
        ("clf", LogisticRegression(solver="liblinear", random_state=42)),
    ]
)

# 5-fold stratified cross-validation
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
accs, gaps = [], []
for tr_idx, val_idx in skf.split(X, y):
    X_tr, X_val = X.iloc[tr_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y.iloc[tr_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]
    prot_val = prot.iloc[val_idx]
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    preds = model.predict(X_val)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, preds)
    # Equal opportunity gap: max-min TPR per protected attribute
    diffs = []
    for col in protected_cols:
        grp_vals = prot_val[col].unique()
        tprs = []
        for gv in grp_vals:
            mask = prot_val[col] == gv
            positives = y_val[mask] == 1
            if positives.sum() > 0:
                tpr = ((preds[mask] == 1) & positives).sum() / positives.sum()
                tprs.append(tpr)
        if len(tprs) > 1:
            diffs.append(max(tprs) - min(tprs))
    gap = np.mean(diffs) if diffs else 0.0
    accs.append(acc)
    gaps.append(gap)

mean_acc = np.mean(accs)
mean_gap = np.mean(gaps)
composite = mean_acc - mean_gap
print(f"Composite metric: {composite:.4f}")

# Retrain on full data and predict test set
model.fit(X, y)
X_test = test[features]
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test.index, "admitted": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)
